payload.subject: The follow-up sequence that works while you sleep
payload.html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Confession: most follow-up doesn't fail because someone's lazy.


It fails because a lead messages at 9pm on a Tuesday, and nobody's there to catch it.


The old way: a lead goes cold overnight, then gets a rushed callback the next afternoon — if they get one at all.


The AI Growth Engine works the opposite way.


It replies in the moment the lead reaches out, then keeps the conversation moving until a call lands on your calendar.


Picture a small independent practice running late-night DMs and missed calls through a sequence like this instead of a shared inbox.


No one has to wake up to answer a Sunday-night message anymore.


The system replies right away, asks a couple of qualifying questions, and drops a link straight onto the calendar.


By the time the practice opens Monday, there's already a discovery call booked from over the weekend.


That's not a hypothetical.


It's just what happens when follow-up doesn't have to wait for a human to be at a desk.


Here's the thing…


This works best for businesses that book 1:1 appointments — consultations, intro sessions, discovery calls.


If that's not how you sell, this one's not for you.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}?


Book a quick discovery call and I'll show you what The AI Growth Engine would look like running in {{business_name}}.


Talk soon,


Dylan | Digigrowth


P.S. — this isn't a sales pitch, just 20 minutes to see if it's a fit.
